high_level_description: This image captures a group of four astronauts inside the International Space Station (ISS). They are all dressed in black T-shirts with NASA logos and American flags on them, indicating their affiliation with NASA. The astronauts are smiling and giving thumbs-up gestures, suggesting a positive and celebratory mood. The setting is the interior of the ISS, which is characterized by its compact and utilitarian design. Various pieces of equipment, cables, and storage compartments are visible in the background.
